answer: Hardware enclave attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to verify code execution within certified silicon. To resist a rising tide of simulated peers, the network enforces an authentication ridge tied to factory keys. An attacker deploying a bot meadow incurs the verifiable cost of buying discrete physical security chips per identity. A major limitation is that hardware side-channel attacks can leak signing keys, enabling adversaries to forge attestations on arbitrary devices.
